pro_course_detail.title: Speaking lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be conversation based and YOU will be doing most of the speaking. Either you will pick topics or I will pick topics that are relevant to your English journey- you can decide.

I will correct some of your mistakes during the lesson. I don't correct every single mistake but I will either correct you on the spot or will note all important mistakes. Sometimes it's necessary to wait until you have completed a sentence or thought before any correction should be done- it's important to also practice flow when speaking a foreign language. 

You will receive feedback from me via email after (or at the very end of) each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: General English lessons / Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons:

Our lessons will incorporate speaking, listening, writing, and grammar. Lessons will be tailored to meet your needs! I will send notes after each lesson, share relevant materials, and assign homework.

While we are in our lessons, we will probably divide the time up into two categories - speaking and grammar. Half the time we will focus on grammar, and half the time on speaking. Homework assigned will usually require you to do some writing, listening, reading, and definitely reviewing. 

After the first few lessons, I'll make a plan for us to follow- it's usually about a 40-lesson syllabus. We don't have to follow it, but it will be a helpful guide for us.

Grammar lessons:

In these lessons, we'll dive deep into all the questions that you might have about grammar. If you don't have specific questions, I will guide you with resources and I will explain with clarity how and why we formulate our sentences the way that we do. I will provide you with trustworthy, additional resources so you can learn from multiple perspectives. Our lessons will be completely customized to meet your needs.

Sometimes I teach grammar in the lessons and then assign homework- and sometimes I first assign homework and then the student "presents" what they've learned. Both systems work really well- the first system working well with A1-B2 students, and the second working well with B2-C1 students.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Workout*
pro_course_detail.description:
If you need to simply chat with a native speaker to practice your English, these informal conversation lessons are just for you. Perhaps you have a presentation you need to practice for, or a speaking exam tomorrow, or you're getting ready to travel abroad and need to warm up a bit. You will bring the topics and you will steer the conversation! 

*Lessons for adults only. Please note that if you'd like homework, lesson plans, or written feedback please take my speaking lessons instead.

pro_course_detail.title: English for young learners
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be mostly conversation based with lots of activities and games, especially with very young learners. This is an important age for language learning because kids learn QUICKLY and EASILY, and they learn the best without formal teaching. Students are pushed to speak, but on their own time- I build trust and focus on their confidence before any formal teaching. With most of my younger learners, I encourage NO formal teaching; it is better that they see me as a "friend" rather than a teacher (kids have enough school already!). At the end of the day, the lesson style is up to the parent- if the parent prefers me to formally teach, I will do that. 
When I am not "formally teaching" I am noting the student's frequent mistakes and new words, and I use the drilling method. After lots of repetition they will naturally correct their mistakes. 
*I only teach 30 minute lessons with very young learners- if there is a specific circumstance we can discuss 45-minute lessons. 
**For kids only.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Adults of All Levels, Beginners to Advanced
pro_course_detail.description:
From beginners to advanced students, I can help you work towards the next level in the development of your English language skills. Each course that I offer is adapted to your level and to your personal interests. 

I can help you reactivate your past knowledge of English, consolidate your current knowledge of English, and advance towards the next level. 

I can give you the opportunity to work on speaking practice, vocabulary, common expressions, general conversation, grammar, reading and listening skills, writing, pronunciation and other aspects of English, in the balance that you need and desire. 

We can work on all of the items on this list, or only on the things that you want to work on. I can also help you feel more comfortable and self-confident when speaking English and I can correct documents that you write in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English for People Who Want to Succeed
pro_course_detail.description:
You choose the focus of this course, which will be adapted to your level and to your special needs. The course can focus on the business English skills that you need in your current job or to obtain a better job, and can help you learn to use the proper degree of politeness and formality or informality for each situation that you find yourself in, so that you can maximize your interactions with everyone from colleagues to CEOs to prospective clients.

This course can help you master those specific business situations that you encounter in your particular job and fulfill your needs for English in your professional life. That may include work on such things as expressions and practice related to introducing yourself, discussing your job, business meetings, telephone calls, teleconferences, preparing for presentations, writing emails or letters or reports, negotiations, social situations, business dinners and business travel, as well as grammar, vocabulary, conversation and other aspects of general English, if desired. 

I’ve been a manager myself in a large institution and I have run my own business, so I have first hand experience using many business skills in the real world. Also, as a teacher, I’ve worked with doctors and lawyers and top managers from many French and international companies, such as KPMG, HSBC, PricewaterhouseCoopers, France Telecom, Louis Vuitton, Lindt Chocolates and Dior.

SUMMARY :

This course can focus on any business needs or other special professional needs that you have, in the short-term or in the long-term, and help you prepare to meet the challenges of work and a successful career that includes the use of English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Children or Teens, Ages 7-15
pro_course_detail.description:
I’ve been working with children for more than 40 years and I know how to put them at ease and how to reach them.

If children enjoy English they will make faster progress and can develop a lifelong positive association with language learning. 

Using a creative approach and lots of visual elements, plus songs and games, and some materials that I have developed myself, I can help your primary school children get ahead by starting English at a young age and developing a positive attitude towards English. I can get them speaking and help them master pronunciation basics before they have a chance to develop bad habits from listening only to nonnative speakers at school.

I can help your middle school students succeed at school, plus gain a deeper understanding of how the English language works than they can get at school. They can advance beyond the classroom and gain the self-confidence to speak and read and write in English. 

I can teach all kids basic skills, such as how to have a first conversation or learn the vocabulary of the world around them. Depending on the children’s ages, they can also see basic grammar and the logic of how English is constructed, and start to build their speaking, reading, listening, writing and pronunciation skills. 

I can help them understand the English that they are learning at school, too, and do a better job with their school homework and exams, and feel more self-confident when speaking.

My years of experience as an English teacher, children’s librarian and professional storyteller can be put to your service to help your children maximize their potentials as English language learners.

pro_course_detail.title: English for High School and University Students, Ages 16 and Older
pro_course_detail.description:
I’ve been working with teens and young adults for many years so I know how to put them at ease, help them do their best and provide them with a safe environment in which they can express their ideas and gain the self-confidence necessary to speak fluently in English.

Adapting each course to the student’s level and needs, I can help high school and university students do better in their school English classes or prepare for exchange programs in English-speaking countries, with the revision of basic grammar and exposure to more advanced grammar, vocabulary, reading, listening, writing, conversation and pronunciation skills. 

I can help them understand the logic of how English is constructed so that they can move beyond conjugation formulas and use correct English more independently.

In addition, I can help students prepare for national exams, Cambridge exams, and more. 

SUMMARY :

To sum up, I can make students feel more comfortable when speaking English and help them communicate more naturally in English. I can also help them understand the English that they are learning at school in more depth, so that they can do a better job on their school assignments and more effectively prepare for exams.

pro_course_detail.title: CV and Interview Preparation, Exam Preparation or Other Special Needs for English
pro_course_detail.description:
CV OR INTERVIEW PREPARATION :
If you need a CV or to prepare for a school entrance interview or job interview in English, I can help you maximize your chances for success. I’ve written many CVs and had many job interviews and, as a manager, I have interviewed job applicants, so I know what’s needed to perform well. I can help you anticipate possible interview questions and prepare well thought out responses to them. I can offer guidelines on which verb tenses are required to answer specific questions about general skills and experience, about past positions, about current jobs and about future career plans. Advance preparation also builds your self-confidence and prevents hesitation over how to answer questions or how to express responses in English. I’ve helped many people get the jobs that they’d hoped to get. I can help you, too.

EXAM PREPARATION :
Prepare for special exams by focusing on grammar, reading, writing and listening skills, correcting practice exams, and speaking to gain the fluency and self-confidence you need for an important exam. Feeling prepared can help reduce your stress so that you can do your best on exams testing your English level or exams written in English that test your knowledge of other subjects.

OTHER SPECIAL NEEDS :
Do you have some other special need for English ? I can design an entire course to help you read articles on medical subjects, read fairy tales from around the world, write poetry or prepare for a vacation in an English-speaking country. I can edit documents you have written in English, correcting grammar and producing more natural sounding English. Whatever you need, I can plan a special course just for you.

SUMMARY :
This course is designed for your specific needs and goals, whether they involve obtaining your dream job, working in another country, succeeding on an important exam, entering an English-speaking university, making the most of travel, or pursuing some special secret desire related to English literature.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation for Professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
Is pronunciation holding you back from getting a job in another country or advancing your career at home ?

Do you need to speak in English at work, at home or when traveling ?

Have you ever had trouble understanding what English speakers are saying to you ?

Have you ever experienced the frustration of speaking pretty well in English, and yet still not being understood ?

I can help you with these problems.

I've been teaching English since 1998 and have helped students from around the world learn to pronounce English more clearly and correctly. I can explain and help you practice basic English vowel and consonant sounds, silent letters, and inconsistencies in English pronunciation rules. Together we can work on the specific sounds in English that are a problem for people who speak your native language and the distinctions between similar sounding words. I can teach you proper word stress, intonation and sentence stress, and help you with homophones and homonyms, and more.

It’s not that we have difficulties grasping the vocabulary when we see it. Rather, we struggle to recall when we use it, or worse yet, forget to use it frequently enough only to end up back where we began.

This lesson will describe seven proven tactics to overcome this struggle and learn new words faster, recall them more effectively, and remember them forever.

I can help you improve your English in any area, including grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, reading and listening. I can also provide you with general conversation practice - I believe that having natural conversations with native speakers is the best way to become fluent in a language. 

I have learned a foreign language and lived abroad myself. I believe this experience enables me to better guide you on your language journey, as I can see your perspective as a learner.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching method involves helping you find the answers, rather than just showing you or telling you. I believe that if I guide you to discover the knowledge on your own, your lessons will be more memorable.

I believe that having natural conversations is one of the best, most effective ways to master a language. Having conversations with native speakers had a tremendous effect on my French fluency. Your lessons will be personalized just for you, focusing on topics that are relevant to your life and your interests. Above all, your lessons will also be fun and engaging, which makes them more memorable! So, are you ready to learn together? Book a trial lesson! I can’t wait to meet you! :)

exp_info.description: Over the past 18 months, I have gained invaluable experience in teaching English as a Second Language online. I have taught over 600 lessons to students of all ages and abilities, including small children, students learning English for work, students learning English to live in America, and much more. I have developed a unique method for optimal learning, which includes a mixture of conversational and structured practice, with lessons designed specifically for each student.

As the owner of my own online store on Teachers Pay Teachers, I create, develop, and sell digital printable educational resources to teachers around the globe. One of my store's specializations is ESL/EFL resources and lesson plans.

Working as an Environmental Education Intern at Lums Pond State Park, I had the opportunity to educate people of all ages and backgrounds on the beautiful nature surrounding them. I helped run a large variety of educational programs, covering topics such as animal species found in the pond, tree identification, monarch butterfly habitat/migration/conservation, kayaking tours, and much more. I helped people find their passion for the natural world around them.

While pursuing my degree in Zoo Keeping Technology, I completed 700 hours of volunteering in the Education Department at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo. In my role as a Junior Zoo Keeper, I spent much of my time speaking and presenting to Zoo guests, educating them about our animals. I gave talks to groups of all sizes and ages about our animals' care, their anatomy, and our Zoo's role in conservation.

I spent three summers as a volunteer at my local library. I was a part of multiple library programs during my time there, including: Summer Reading Program, Reading Buddies (reading books with young children), and general library duties.

While attending Colorado Springs Early Colleges, I was chosen to be part of our school's National Honor Society. This prestigious group was in charge of carrying out service projects in our community, such as food drives for the homeless.

In my final year of middle school, I was chosen to be part of a program called WEB "Where Everybody Belongs". In this program, I helped 6th graders have a smooth transition into middle school. Our WEB group (all 8th graders) spent time with the kids during their first week of school and checked in on them throughout the year. We helped them do homework, talked to them about their transition, showed them around the campus, and led them in some fun games to help them get to know each other.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Class
pro_course_detail.description:
With this simple course, advanced students can expect to make regular strides in terms of conversational competence and confidence. I will generally not prepare any materials for the class. This approach will challenge students to think, speak and comprehend quickly in order to match the pace of native-level verbal communication.  

Unless a student prefers to review mistakes at the end, I will make a note of all errors made by the student and corrections will be made during conversation at appropriate moments; if necessary, further teaching and practice will be provided to address significant or recurring errors. Lastly, please note that, for the sake of verisimilitude, there will be no set topic or lesson materials provided and no homework assigned. However, if a student wishes to propose conversation topics prior to the class, this will be encouraged.

pro_course_detail.title: Standard Native English Course
pro_course_detail.description:
This course features an approach developed by the teacher over the course of several years’ teaching experience. I will tailor materials to meet individual students' needs while keeping in mind the four fundamental skills: speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

Class time will predominantly be dedicated to speaking and listening (with particular attention devoted to improving pronunciation, intonation and comprehension/thinking/speaking speed). I will carefully select course material prior to each class, including grammar exercises, written dialogues, news articles and YouTube videos, in order to offer students only the most important and practical knowledge for speaking REAL English for work and general communication with NATIVE English speakers. Therefore, students will spend less time learning vocabulary out of context; instead, tricky yet essential aspects of English such as idioms and phrasal verbs, presented in context, will form the basis of a student’s learning.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic Writing (with Revision)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, we will work together to improve your academic writing. This is my specialty and I have tutored many students in this area, helping them successfully prepare application essays, dissertations, and more.

First, we will work on structure for academic essays and formal argumentative style. If you are more experienced, we will work to fine-tune your abilities according to your precise needs and upcoming projects. I am also happy to dedicate classes to specific skills such as assembling a literature review or effectively addressing counter-arguments within your essays. In principle, I am happy and comfortable working on any type of writing, from CVs and emails to dissertations, college applications and even fiction. Finally, included in the price of each lesson, I will proofread and edit up to 500 words of your writing per class and give you detailed comments and feedback.

pro_course_detail.title: Casual Conversation Class (No Video)
pro_course_detail.description: Offered for the purpose of allowing both student and teacher greater flexibility, this no-frills lesson type gives you the opportunity to practice speaking on the go, wherever you are, as long as you have access to a stable internet connection. Though correcting your mistakes will, of course, remain a top priority in this class, the approach will generally be much more casual. Therefore, I would only recommend this option to upper-intermediate and advanced students looking to increase their speaking practice time with a CELTA-qualified teacher. Ideally, the casual conversation class will resemble a spontaneous phone call between friends. To facilitate this and enhance flexibility, please note that video will not be used.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we’ll dive into the things you’re passionate about—your interests, hobbies, and what makes you tick. Whether it’s the latest blockbuster movie, your favorite TV show, a thrilling sports match, or even today’s trending news, we’ll use these topics to spark fun and engaging conversations. Think of this as a laid-back chat, where you can relax, express yourself, and explore your thoughts in English without feeling pressured.

Mistakes are more than welcome here—they’re your stepping stones to growth and part of the exciting journey to mastering a new language. Together, we’ll celebrate progress, laugh off missteps, and build your confidence in a positive, encouraging atmosphere. So, let’s make this lesson a space where learning is as fun as discussing your favorite Netflix series or cheering for your team in the final moments of the game. Ready to get started? Let’s dive in and make learning feel like catching up with a good friend!

pro_course_detail.title: Travel Talk
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to a class that takes you on an exciting journey around the world—no passport or packing required! Together, we’ll explore rich cultures, fascinating traditions, and mouthwatering cuisines while diving into how travel inspires, connects, and occasionally confuses us.
Whether you’re a seasoned globetrotter or still dreaming of your first big adventure, this course is your chance to broaden your perspective and have some fun along the way. So, grab your (imaginary) bags, and let’s embark on this adventure—just don’t forget your virtual boarding pass!

pro_course_detail.title: Topic / Conversation Roulette
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to a twist on our usual conversation practice! Get ready for a fun and exciting roulette-style lesson. We’ll spin a virtual roulette wheel, and whatever topic or conversation question it lands on will be the theme for the lesson.  
Whether it’s discussing your favorite hobbies, the latest movies, current events, or even a deep dive into cultural traditions, the roulette will decide the direction of our conversation. It’s a unique and spontaneous way to spark new ideas, explore interesting topics, and have fun while practicing your English.  
Let’s see what the wheel has in store—are you ready to spin and dive into some exciting conversations? Let the fun begin!
